The DashScope domain is the legacy shared domain; workspace-dedicated domains ([workspace-id].[region].maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1) and regional domains (dashscope-intl/us.aliyuncs.com) are also documented, as is an Anthropic-compatible root at https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/apps/anthropic.
